name: Jev Reply Gate
description: Uses TypeSafe Jev for fast typed judgments around the agent: whether to answer a group message, and which model tier a request needs. Each feature has its own switch.

assistantName.label: Assistant name override
assistantName.help: Leave empty to use the agent's identity.name from the OpenClaw config. Set it to show Jev a different name. The override also counts as a mention.

assistantDescription.label: Assistant description
assistantDescription.help: One or two sentences on what the assistant is for. Jev uses it to judge relevance.

bufferSize.label: Context buffer size
bufferSize.help: How many recent messages per conversation are kept as context for Jev. Shared by every feature. Default 8.

replyGate.enabled.label: Reply gate
replyGate.enabled.help: On by default. Asks Jev whether the assistant should answer each group message. Mentions always get an answer.

replyGate.threshold.label: Reply threshold
replyGate.threshold.help: Reply when Jev's probability that an answer is wanted is at or above this value (0 to 1). Default 0.6.

replyGate.mentionPatterns.label: Mention patterns
replyGate.mentionPatterns.help: Extra names or /regex/i patterns that count as a mention, on top of OpenClaw's own mention patterns. A mention always gets an answer.

replyGate.evaluateDirectMessages.label: Evaluate direct messages
replyGate.evaluateDirectMessages.help: Off by default: direct messages are always answered. Turn on to gate them too.

replyGate.failOpen.label: Reply when Jev is unreachable
replyGate.failOpen.help: On by default: a Jev error lets the message through to the model. Off keeps the bot silent unless mentioned.

modelRouter.enabled.label: Model router
modelRouter.enabled.help: Off by default. Asks Jev how much work a request takes and what is at stake, then picks a model tier for that run.

modelRouter.tiers.light.label: Light model
modelRouter.tiers.light.help: provider/model for small talk and simple lookups, e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5. Empty keeps the agent's model.

modelRouter.tiers.standard.label: Standard model
modelRouter.tiers.standard.help: provider/model for everyday requests and every uncertain case. Empty keeps the agent's model.

modelRouter.tiers.heavy.label: Heavy model
modelRouter.tiers.heavy.help: provider/model for hard or high-stakes requests. Empty keeps the agent's model.

modelRouter.lightBelow.label: Light below
modelRouter.lightBelow.help: Effort (0 to 1) at or below this can take the light tier. Default 0.34.

modelRouter.heavyAbove.label: Heavy above
modelRouter.heavyAbove.help: Effort (0 to 1) at or above this takes the heavy tier. Default 0.8.

modelRouter.minConfidence.label: Minimum confidence for light
modelRouter.minConfidence.help: Below this confidence in the effort score, a request never takes the light tier. Default 0.5.

modelRouter.maxPromptChars.label: Prompt characters sent to Jev
modelRouter.maxPromptChars.help: Counted from the end of the prompt, where the current message sits. Default 4000.

apiKey.label: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.help: A SecretRef such as {"source":"store","provider":"default","id":"TYPESAFE_API_KEY"}, or a plain string. Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.
